vulnerability_title: UniswapV2 price TWAP accumulator underflow will lead to oracle update failure

content_code_consistency.content_reasoning: The contract uses Solidity 0.8.20, and update subtracts the Uniswap cumulative prices and timestamps without an unchecked block. When an accumulator wraps around, the subtraction reverts and update fails, leaving consult on stale averages.
patterns_found: checked subtraction on accumulators that are meant to wrap
issues: UniTWAPOracle, which the finding gives as the correct version, is a different contract.

scsvs_classification.vulnerability_type: accumulator underflow makes the oracle update revert
